dialogues.text: I received a letter from a young director for a new action film. It was a rare opportunity, I'd like to give it a shot.
Good. You're here. This is not a normal audition.
I noticed. Normal auditions don't hand you a katana.
I'm making an action film. A mysterious student, a blade, and a gang that picked the wrong enemy.
Sounds like you've been watching too much John Wick and Kill Bill.
I'm a big fan. Now I need to see if you can carry that role.
Swing! Strike! Slash!(Use <sprite name="ps"> to attack) Finish that dummy!
